edits.new:
The texts are copied unchanged from the legacy story; the deployment adds the alert routing and the runbook link, never a new wording.

While v_ace_batch_status does not exist (RWB-ACE-001 not deployed), the batch gate answers as it does for an incomplete batch: 409 with MSG-P1-001, no candidate and no break row. DP01 is never stamped LOADED for that date, so the case creation job creates no case for that date. The gate is read from the view only and is never inferred from data_as_of, a row count or a file. The refusal status 409 and the two filled fields of MSG-P1-001 are fixed in the published contract and settled in ASM-B-P1-07-E1018-4.
